title: Predication fiber functor
description: The transfinite predication-tier precursor to predication-fibration: the contravariant functor F from the opposite predicate-category to distributive bilattice-valued predicate fibers. It presents the raw fiber data and the four-generator reindexing action before positing packages the same data as a cloven Grothendieck fibration for Scott-continuous rule firing. This object is structural; it is not a valuation, trace, or finite graph of assignments.

cell-set.description: The predication-cell-set Phi = E x Pi x E whose predicate coordinate indexes the fibers.

base.description: The base predicate-category C. Its four generator families determine the contravariant reindexing action.

entity-set.description: The entity-set E used by every predicate fiber A_p = L^twist^(E x E).

bilattice.description: The bilattice coordinate supplying the distributive bilattice codomain of each predicate-indexed fiber.
